subject: cor-real-spectral-theorem-for-self-adjoint-endomorphisms

alert_exact.finding: Step 2.1 says: “every $2\times2$ block collapses to the scalar block $[a]$.” Setting b=0 makes the displayed 2×2 block equal to aI₂, retaining two coordinates; [a] denotes a 1×1 block. The subsequent diagonality and eigenbasis conclusions remain valid, but this block-size wording is inaccurate.

scope: Proposal only; no canonical source write before root ordinary pre-edit claim release.

mathematical_assessment.defect: The displayed B is a 2 by 2 matrix. B=B^T forces b=-b, hence b=0 over the reals, so B=diag(a,a), retaining both coordinates. The literal 1 by 1 block [a] has the wrong dimension.
mathematical_assessment.supplier_hypotheses: The actual normal-classification supplier Statement is stronger than local L2: its 2 by 2 rotation-scaling blocks require b!=0. Under this stronger convention symmetry excludes all such blocks, leaving the 1 by 1 blocks already diagonal. The local proof uses the weaker valid block-form consequence, allowing b=0, in which case its two coordinates are already eigenvectors. Both readings establish the current unchanged Statement.
mathematical_assessment.zero_dimension: For the zero-dimensional space the empty orthonormal basis and empty diagonal decomposition remain valid; the replacement introduces no positive-dimension restriction.

proposed_edit.before: 2.1 Because $T$ is self-adjoint, [L3] says that the same matrix is symmetric. A block $B$ above is symmetric exactly when $b=0$, so every $2\times2$ block collapses to the scalar block $[a]$. Therefore the whole matrix is diagonal. [L3, step 1.1, algebra]
proposed_edit.after: 2.1 Because $T$ is self-adjoint, [L3] says that the same matrix is symmetric. A block $B$ above is symmetric exactly when $b=0$, so every $2\times2$ block is the diagonal block $aI_2=\operatorname{diag}(a,a)$. Therefore the whole matrix is diagonal. [L3, step 1.1, algebra]
proposed_edit.reason: One phrase correction preserves the two coordinates and makes the diagonality inference literal. No reblocking, new basis choice, Statement change, or Definition change is needed.

consumer_interface_assessment.public_interface: Every finite-dimensional real self-adjoint endomorphism has an orthonormal eigenbasis, with exactly the original hypotheses and conclusion.
consumer_interface_assessment.actual_use: F4 quotes exactly the eigenbasis conclusion. Proof 3.1 uses it on each real self-adjoint positive definite S_i to diagonalize R_i and read eigenvalues (alpha-sigma)/(alpha+sigma). Neither use depends on the erroneous internal block dimension.
consumer_interface_assessment.other_consumers: A read-only repository reference search shows many published consumers of the eigenbasis result. Their statements are not affected by this internal wording correction; no claim is made here to have independently rereviewed all their proofs.
consumer_interface_assessment.scope_limit: This focused check verifies the corollary, its three actual direct supplier items in full, and the exact ALE consumer in full. It is not a new whole-corpus spectral-theorem audit.
